title: 保罗·保罗·克鲁格曼：就业市场疲软，对凯文·沃什观点感到不安
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Just a few hours removed from the latest US monthly jobs report about 57,000 jobs created in the most recent quarter revisions for the prior two months, I should say.
segments.zh: 距离最新美国月度就业报告发布仅几小时，该报告显示最近一个季度修正后前两个月新增约5.7万个就业岗位。

segments.en: I am curious about how you view these numbers on a month-to-month basis. I know in the past you've talked about them being noisy. Does 57,000 this month and those downward revisions
segments.zh: 我很好奇你如何看待这些月度数据。我知道你过去曾说过它们有噪音。这个月的5.7万以及前两个月的下修，

segments.en: from the prior two? Is that noise? Yeah, there's no reason to think that anything much is changing
segments.zh: 是噪音吗？是的，没有理由认为月度间会发生太大变化。

segments.en: month-to-month. We have an overall picture which I think is pretty clear which is that US job growth has downshifted from where it was soon after Trump took office but it's shifted down
segments.zh: 整体情况我认为相当清晰：美国就业增长已从特朗普上任后不久的水平放缓，但放缓幅度

segments.en: roughly in line with the slowing of labor force growth because of the crackdown and immigration and the overall tightness of the labor market isn't changing much and everything else is just
segments.zh: 大致与劳动力增长放缓同步，原因是移民打击和劳动力市场整体紧张程度变化不大，其他都是对极端嘈杂信号的过度解读。

segments.en: overreading what are really extremely noisy signals. Well I am curious about that and you mentioned the drop that we've seen in immigration and there's been a lot of talk and I know you've
segments.zh: 我对此很好奇，你提到了移民减少，有很多讨论，我知道你在Substack上写过关于就业市场盈亏平衡点的文章。

segments.en: written about this and your substacks about this idea of where the break even a rate right now is in the job market. I mean how should we sort of view this data even on a trend level given
segments.zh: 考虑到劳动力结构正在发生重大结构性变化，我们应如何看待这些数据，即使是趋势层面的？

segments.en: that there are major structural changes going on with regards to the complexion of our workforce?
segments.zh: 是的，这很难跟踪，部分原因是所有劳动力数据，尽管BLS尽力保持专业，但

segments.en: Yeah I mean it's always it's kind of hard to keep track of this in part because even in all labor force data despite the best efforts of the BLS which remains extremely professional but
segments.zh: 确实，要跟踪这些数据有点难，部分原因是尽管劳工统计局非常专业，但劳动力数据本身就很复杂。
